entities.summary: Darius I, a notable figure in the history of Pakistan, associated with Achaemenid, Greek, and Mauryan Period (518 BCE–305 BCE). Preceded by Persian and Alexandrian Period. Their legacy influenced Maurya Empire and Ashoka.
